name: Skin Texture Temporal Analysis
description: Examines skin texture consistency and micro-detail preservation across video frames.
useCase: Detecting AI-generated faces through temporal skin texture anomalies
mechanism: Analyzes pore-level skin texture, wrinkle patterns, and micro-surface details across consecutive frames. AI-generated faces often show unnatural smoothness, texture flickering, or inconsistent skin detail levels that vary between frames.
source: Li, L. et al. (2020) - Face X-Ray for More General Face Forgery Detection, CVPR
algorithm: Texture Feature Extraction (LBP/Gabor) + Temporal Coherence + Statistical Analysis
parameters: Patch size: 32x32, Features: LBP, Gabor magnitude, Texture gradient, Frame window: 15
strengths:
• Detects subtle texture inconsistencies
• Effective on high-resolution video
• Works on face generation and face swap
• Complements geometric analysis methods
limitations:
• Requires close-up face shots
• Makeup or filters can interfere
• Less effective at low resolution
• Lighting changes affect texture features

references.title: Li, L. et al. (2020). Face X-Ray for More General Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
Liu, H. et al. (2021). Spatial-Phase Shallow Learning: Rethinking Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
Shiohara, K. & Yamasaki, T. (2022). Detecting Deepfakes with Self-Blended Images. CVPR.
